table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	  purinvcode = dbo.purledger.purinvcode,    
       date = dbo.purledger.date,   
       invdiscperc = dbo.purledger.discperc, 
       flatdisc = dbo.purledger.flatdisc,    
       misccharges = dbo.purledger.misccharges, 
		 invgstperc1 = dbo.purledger.invgstperc1,	
       invsalestax = dbo.purledger.salestax,
		 invtype = Case dbo.purledger.purcatcode 	When 1 Then 'Pack Purchase (Cash)'
																When 2 Then 'Pack Purchase (Credit)' 
																When 7 Then 'Loose Purchase (Cash)'
																When 8 Then 'Loose Purchase (Credit)'
																Else 'Opening Purchase' End,  	   
       purchasetype = (SELECT dbo.purchasetype.name FROM dbo.purchasetype WHERE dbo.purchasetype.purtypecode = dbo.purledger.purtypecode),
		 looseqty = dbo.purdetail.looseqty, 
		 packqty  = purdetail.packqty, 
		 quantity = dbo.purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty, 
		 bonusqty  = purdetail.bonusqty, 	  
       price = dbo.purdetail.purprice,    
       itemdiscperc = dbo.purdetail.discperc,
		 unitsalestax = dbo.purdetail.unitsalestax,
       gstperc = dbo.purdetail.gstperc,    
		 packunits = dbo.purdetail.packunits,    
		 packing=  case when dbo.item.packcode is null then space(30)
                   else  dbo.itempacking.name
                 end,
       batch = dbo.purdetail.batch,    
		 expiry = dbo.purdetail.expiry,    
		 itemname = item.name,
		 datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, purledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, purledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, purledger.date)))), 
		 Person = dbo.accounts.name,
       Posted=dbo.purledger.posted,
		 totalsalestax = (SELECT invtotalsalestax= 
										  Round (
		 /*invoice level salestax*/Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( ( PD.looseqty + PD.packqty ) * PD.purprice * (1 - PD.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
							  	       * ( 1 - PL.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - PL.flatdisc ) * PL.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 )
 		 /*items salestax*/		 + Sum (Round ( (PD.looseqty + PD.packqty + PD.bonusqty)* PD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( (PD.looseqty + PD.packqty) * PD.purprice * (1 - PD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * PD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )						 
										 , 0 )
							 FROM dbo.Purledger PL , 
							      dbo.Purdetail PD
	
							 WHERE  (PL.purinvcode = dbo.purledger.purinvcode )   and
									  (PL.purinvcode = PD.purinvcode )   
         
							 GROUP BY PL.purinvcode, 
			  							 PL.invgstperc1, 
										 PL.misccharges,   
										 PL.flatdisc,
		  								 PL.discperc
							)

FROM 	
	dbo.purledger, 
	dbo.purdetail,    
	dbo.item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN itempacking  ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
	dbo.accounts
WHERE  dbo.purledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	dbo.purledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.purledger.purcatcode IN (1, 2, 3, 7, 8) and
	dbo.purledger.suppcode =:ai_suppcode and
	dbo.purledger.purinvcode = dbo.purdetail.purinvcode and  
	dbo.purdetail.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.purledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode

objects.name: c_totalmisccharges
objects.expression: sum(  misccharges for all Distinct  purinvcode  )

objects.name: c_wholesalecash
objects.expression: sum(  Round(( quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )   , 2)   for all )

objects.name: c_totaldisc
objects.expression: sum(  flatdisc for all Distinct  purinvcode  )

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: Round ( Sum( c_amount for all) + sum( misccharges for all distinct  purinvcode ) -  sum(  flatdisc  for all distinct  purinvcode ) -  sum(  Round(( quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) * (   invdiscperc  * 0.01 )   , 2)   for all ) , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))  + Round ( Sum ( totalsalestax  for all distinct purinvcode ) , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon') )

objects.name: c_totalinvdiscvalue
objects.expression: sum(  Round(( quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) * (   invdiscperc  * 0.01 )   , 2)   for all )

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( Sum ( totalsalestax for all distinct purinvcode ) , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))

objects.name: c_itemsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( Round ( Round(( quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )   , 2)  * ( gstperc * 0.01) , 2 ) + ( unitsalestax * (quantity + bonusqty) )  , 2 )

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round ( Sum(  (quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) for group 2 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 ) - flatdisc + misccharges + invsalestax , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon')) + Round ( c_invsalestax + Sum ( c_itemsalestax for group 2 ) , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon') )

objects.name: c_invsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( ( Sum(  (quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) for group 2 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  - flatdisc  ) * ( invgstperc1 * 0.01 ),  2)
